_comment: The unified image-correlation model (ImageCorrelationModel). One fit over the spatiotemporal carpet G(xi, psi, Delta): RICS, STICS, TICS and iMSD are readings of it, not separate models. Optional terms start at their neutral value and are fixed; release one to switch it on.

sections.title: Transport
sections.description: Particle number, transport coefficient and the anomalous exponent. Release alpha to fit an anomalous MSD (the iMSD case): the model width is w_r^2 + 4*D*tau^alpha.

sections.title: Imaging (acquisition)
sections.description: Scan timing and PSF. These fix the lag time tau = |xi*t_pix + psi*t_line + Delta*t_frame|, i.e. what 'time' each part of the carpet means.

sections.title: Blinking
sections.description: Triplet/blinking term. Amplitude zero switches it off.

sections.title: Immobile fraction / shift
sections.description: Static component with its own width, plus a lateral shift for cross-correlation (ccRICS). N_imm = 0 removes it.

sections.title: Flow
sections.description: Uniform flow along the fast/slow scan axes. Zero velocities remove the term.
